barRaise.topFinding: The stall held for a fourth day, but two things moved and one number moved a lot. The unpushed commit cleared: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main returns 0d4f2ae, so the corrected GDD tab list in CLAUDE.md is on GitHub and the two-day-local signal from the last two reports is closed. Against that, the nightly audit reached a surface no prior pass had walked and found the GitHub repo description still selling the retired 2D game, closing on "Hand-painted, true 2:1 isometric" against native-3D framing in README.md:3, project.godot and CLAUDE.md:8, which itself tags that exact phrasing [legacy-2D] at line 21. That finding matters out of proportion to its MEDIUM severity, because it is the first HBH item in four drift-auto-fix passes that is not behind the release gate: it needs one gh repo edit and an explicit go, not a pill bump. Everything else is unchanged. The undocumented v0.99.41 release is day 4 with all four self-stamp sites re-verified present in source/autoloads/debug_flags.gd:10 and source/autoloads/economy.gd:18,20,34 and still zero occurrences of 0.99.41 anywhere in the GDD. The queue slice went 131 to 132 with zero items worked and still zero auto_safe. The number that moved is chronic count: 67 findings from the 2026-07-24 cohort ticked from 4 runs open to 5, so chronic went 30 to 97, and 82 percent of the open action list is now chronic by the skill's own definition.

actions.title: Raise the four base caps or seed the run above them, wire the Warehouse placement path to call economy.register_warehouse, then re-check every catalog and research cost against the reachable ceiling.
Re-bundle personal-skills-src and reinstall it so the loaded copy points at X:\HereBeHordes and X:\YesAndScheduler, starting with htbh-changelog-entry's GDD path.
Cap the per-run HBH auto-enqueue at the top N findings and route the rest to the report only, or stand up an attended HBH drain lane.

Require the splice anchor to be unique in both files and reject any recovery whose output is below about 90% of the baseline bytes, in both check_gdd_integrity.py and publish-gdd.ps1's Test-GddIntegrity.
Compute var gdt := delta * game_clock.get_time_scale() at world_3d.gd:323, pass it to every gameplay tick and to enemy_field_3d._physics_process, then bind F1-F4 to game_clock.set_time_scale_index.
Route world_3d._research_tech and _do_research through research.try_start and research.is_*_unlocked, or formally retire source/autoloads/research.gd and delete its [autoload] entry.
Drive game_clock.set_paused from world_3d._toggle_pause and _end_game so one pause state governs both halves.
Whitelist every incoming progress and assets value against the STATES enum inside syncFromCanonical and rebuild the indicator with createElement plus textContent instead of innerHTML concatenation.

Re-run the three crowd baselines with world_builder.make_directional_light() in the harnesses and set cast_shadow = SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF on the per-Node enemy meshes and the crowd3d node, recording both in OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md.
Switch the in-run rebakes to bake_navigation_mesh(true) behind a short debounce timer and collapse the _load_run restore loop into a single bake after the loop finishes.
Pick one research implementation, delete or explicitly quarantine the other, and make economy.gd's cap-bonus lookup point at whichever survives.
Cap HBH bar-raise auto-enqueue to the top ten findings per run and hold the rest in the report until the pending slice is back under thirty.
Route _toggle_pause through game_clock.set_paused and bail enemy_field_3d._physics_process, defense_system and unit_controller on that single flag.
Give campaign missions a real per-mission wave cap or an authored win predicate so all_waves_cleared can fire and a mission can unlock the next.
File a locked decision that either admits the 136-card Dispatches catalog into v1 with a backlog row and an M5 deliverable, or cuts it to the shipped 7-card draft and marks the catalog v2.
Rewrite choose_mode.gd:47 as a clipped Order 42 operator brief and lock the same register as the template for missions 2 through 6 before their desc strings get written.
Uninstall the duplicate copies so handler-audit, project-canonical-audit and bar-raise each have exactly one registered installation sourced from personal-skills-src.
Re-bundle code-audit so the post-2026-06-29 HTBH.md hazard catalog naming source/world3d is the copy loaded in HBH sessions.
Make queue-drain refuse to set status=completed on any item carrying a release_note until the named release step has run, or introduce a distinct code-landed-release-pending status.
Install a repo pre-commit hook that runs the four guards and add a -Message parameter to push-to-github.ps1.
Change bar-raise-hordes/SKILL.md:10 to a fully-qualified skill id pinned to the fixed copy, or delete and refresh the stale anthropic-skills:bar-raise upload.

Rewrite the post-write gate at 05_meta_synthesis.md:114 to resolve each openFindings id by exact (project, finding_id) tuple against the live queue plus the archive, fail loudly on any miss, and reconcile the printed count against the enumerated list.

Rewrite the dedupe at 05_meta_synthesis.md:111 onto a dated content-stable slug, restrict the live-queue match to non-terminal statuses, add an archive lookup, and add a same-run cross-lens duplicate collapse before enqueue.

Add a change-detected worker-deploy step to release.ps1 modelled on YesAndChains release.ps1:367-399, or execute the delete-versus-keep call first so the step is not built for a worker about to be removed.
Stop emitting the credential literal from publish-gdd.ps1:303 and either move /hordes/ behind a real server-side check or re-scope the mirror as public and drop the gate.

Rewrite the changelog and the two workflow locked decisions in first-person solo dev-log voice, deleting the memory-key dump and tool names and dropping the quoted prompts to the design decision they produced.

Add zero-tolerance RULES entries to check_gdd_voice.py for AI tool names, agent vocabulary, the snake_case memory-key list shape and assistant/reply/chat, then neutralize the roughly 30 existing hits so the new baselines can be set at 0.
Re-rank the HBH queue so R3D-04 is the single P1 and demote all sixteen apparatus P1s to P3 except the two touching a live public surface (security-03, gate-page-publish-01).
Have _seed_economy and ensure_endless write through a cap-bypassing setter or raise the cap first, so the exported start values and the endless toggle take effect.
Build the mission data layer (R3D-04) so each campaign mission loads authored objectives, waves, layout and a win predicate instead of the fixed sandbox preset.
Collapse the four named pairs into one item each, keeping the earlier id, and add a title-similarity check to the enqueue writer alongside the finding_id key.
Make world_3d._toggle_pause delegate to game_clock.set_paused and gate world_3d._process on game_clock.paused so there is one pause authority.
Gate _on_pause_save and _on_pause_load on not _game_over and close the pause menu from _end_game so every save-load entry point matches the hotkey gating.
Route world3d spends through economy.charge()/can_afford(), power through register_power_supply(), and deaths through the record_* hooks, deleting whatever stays unreachable after that pass.
Attach nav agents on the crowd branch of spawn_wave regardless of _use_crowd, or push_warning and force use_navigation false at enemy_field_3d.gd:88.
Wire auto_pause end to end against the 3D stack or delete it with its four settings toggles and its project.godot autoload entry.
Add scripts/preship.ps1 that runs the Godot tests headlessly plus the python guards and gate release.ps1 on it with an env-var bypass.
Autosave or prompt on the pause-menu and quit paths and implement the autosave_freq timer against game_clock day advances.
Require a shared write token on POST and reject requests whose Origin is absent or not in the allowlist, then retire the legacy htbh worker.
Move both gate literals into an X:\.secrets\HereBeHordes file that publish-gdd.ps1 reads at publish time, matching the discord-notify.ps1 pattern.
Pause the AnimationPlayer and clear visibility on dormant and off-camera enemies, restoring both on wake, and log the measured delta as an OPTIMIZATION_LOG row.
Persist the enemy field or refuse to save while alive_count() is above 0, and clear _enemy_field inside _clear_run.
Serialise _techs_done into the save and restore it before rebuilding the research panel, marking each restored tech done on the HUD.
Delete both autoloads with their project.godot entries and the orphaned toggle_noise_overlay keybind, or rewrite both headers to state plainly that they are unwired scaffolding.
Refresh the four line-count claims to 957 and 351, resolve the A1 row against A3, and re-date the section-5 all-clear.
Add scripts/drain-audit.ps1 that reads the newest docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-*.md, applies its GDD edits with the Python atomic write, bumps the pill once and hands off to release.ps1.
Add a short-lived toast method to game_hud.gd and call it from the placement, train, research and market refusal branches naming the missing resource or the unmet gate.
Aggregate cost by $taskProj alongside the per-day and per-model buckets in collect-usage.ps1 and emit it as projects.<id>.routines.
Append the per-day cost series to usage-log/Hordes.jsonl on every collect and derive the append gate from the newest day bucket rather than from the floored allTime.
Add an ASSET_PROVENANCE.md row recording the Tripo3D bridge's source, pinned version 1.0.0 and licence and correct the two-fonts claim, or delete the addon and its project.godot entries.
Add a debug_flags-gated 1 Hz sampler appending the FPS and alive-count pair already computed at world_3d.gd:521-522 plus Performance.TIME_PROCESS to a per-run CSV under user://.
Delete the six reader-less debug flags or wire verbose_pathing to real gated prints in the live world3d spawn, target and rally paths.
Mirror _load_failed with a _save_failed(reason) helper that pushes to _game_hud.set_status for the three branches at world_3d.gd:731, :740 and :744.
Restore a minimal CREDITS.md (Godot engine MIT plus logo CC BY, Electrolize OFL, Mortend) and drop the OFL text into assets/fonts/ before the first export preset is created.
Correct the third-party inventory in ASSET_PROVENANCE.md:65-67 and ASSETS.md:36-38 to list the Tripo bridge addon and the Godot logo alongside the two fonts, each with its licence status.
Delete the BUILDS cost dictionary and route the number-key path through BuildingCatalog3D.get_def so one table prices every build.
Convert world_3d._unhandled_input and iso_cam_3d to Input.is_action_* against the input_defaults actions and wire the four speed actions to game_clock.set_time_scale_index.
Add a HUD toast with a reason string to the five silent bail paths and back it with the toast_duration option already in settings.
Expose wave_director's remaining time in the game HUD with a horde-incoming alert as the timer nears zero.
Wire _on_building_placed to call economy.register_power_supply and register_power_draw from each building's prod spec so brownout and the placer headroom check start mattering.
Add a backlog row for skirmish mode that names its R3D-04 dependency, or strike it from the M5, M7 and section 12 v1 commitments.
Write a locked decision for the Scout cut and propagate it through sections 6, 7 and 8, the Mission 1 spec, the MVP asset row, the research node and the Scout doctrine chain.
Wrap GDD Assets sections C-H in the same hidden data-archived container used for the v0.49.3 block and skip archived rows in renderAssetHero.
Cache each unit's target on a roughly 1s reacquire cadence matching the locked TARGET_REACQUIRE_SEC convention and rewrite _ring_cells to emit only the ring perimeter into a reused member buffer.
Compose the crowd transforms into a reused PackedFloat32Array assigned to multimesh.buffer once per tick and skip records whose position and heading are unchanged.
Cluster or merge overlapping vision discs and sort by relevance before packing them into fog_3d's 64 slots so the cap degrades gracefully.
Add source/Erik/ to ASSET_ROOTS, add a .glb branch checking the glTF magic plus the .import sidecar, and add source/Erik/** to both art-check.yml path filters.
Confirm the artist's current batch and expected drop date and stamp that date on the batch A row in docs/ASSET_PRODUCTION-2026-06-11.md and the GDD Assets production order.

Rename the four wonders into the Order 42 megastructure register and cascade across building_catalog_3d.gd, research.gd and every live GDD tab, following the v0.94.2 procedure and leaving changelog history untouched.
Commit a default_bus_layout.tres mirroring options.gd:197-206 and point project.godot's audio/buses/default_bus_layout at it, keeping _ensure_audio_buses as an idempotent safety net.
Bind the audio slider value_changed to _apply_audio() only and move apply_all() plus _persist() onto drag_ended or a short debounce timer.
Fold the grim-dark-is-art-not-lighting ruling into GDD section 15 so the ambient bullet reads as clean readable lighting carrying grim-dark art.
Pick one canonical artist credit or state the handle-to-name mapping once in docs/ASSET_PROVENANCE.md, and rewrite the GDD section 15 asset-state paragraph to describe the live 3D roster.
Bump SAVE_VERSION to 2, restore saved resource amounts by writing _amounts directly or via a clamp-exempt setter, and push_warning whenever a loaded amount is reduced.

Route all four ResourceSaver.save sites through one helper that writes to a .tmp path, verifies the readback loads, then renames, and give global.gd:11-15 an options.new() fallback when load() returns null.
Bump plugin.json on every re-bundle and record the shipped plugin version in the bar-raise run context.
Exempt the most recent report of each type per project from the retention sweep, or rewrite the source field of items whose report has been deleted so the pointer stops implying recoverable evidence.
Make the age-archive skip any item whose triagedAt is within the retention window with a Keep verdict, and restore hbh-observability-frame-time-logger-2026-07-11 or fold it into a live item by name.
Collapse the five R3D-04 items into the P1 parent with the three 2026-07-24 restatements demoted to explicit blocked-by children.

Parse the newest docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-*.md inside Get-LatestAudit for its HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW counts and write them into audit.findings, and run the writer from audit-hordes-nightly so the pointer refreshes without a release.
Batch the four audit-originated items into one attended release-gated session so a single pill bump discharges all of them.
Split scripts/cf-worker-setup.md into a one-time provisioning section and a redeploy section that starts at wrangler deploy against the committed wrangler.toml.
Delete the $GddDestRelPath variable and the lines 91-115 destination block so the encoded-payload check at :117-170 is the only publish verdict.
Replace the git-guard.ps1:71 pointer with the in-repo Get-Process git plus stale-timestamp steps from CLAUDE.md and add refs/heads/<branch>.lock to the Assert-GitSafe lock list at :22.
Add a step to audit-hordes-nightly/SKILL.md that runs scripts/write-dashboard-status.ps1 after the audit, on the zero-drift path too.
Fully qualify the invocation at handler-audit-nightly/SKILL.md:6 and rebuild the registered copy from the six-handler source.
Rebuild and re-upload the personal-skills plugin from source so the pinned copy carries Phase 4.5 and the REPORT_CONTRACT fields, then re-verify the pin.
Exempt any report still cited by a non-terminal queue item from consolidate-audit-files.ps1 pruning, or copy the cited evidence into each queue item at enqueue time.

Add bar-raise-finding and canonical-audit-finding to the work-queue-runner kind enum with the drift-fix gate applied to both, and either teach drift-auto-fix Phase 1 to accept docs/BAR_RAISE-*.md or state that only work-queue-runner consumes them.
Add an attended HBH drain lane that presents shell-gated items for one bulk greenlight, and set auto_safe true on the text-only subset.
Delete write-dashboard-status.ps1:231-237 and let the Assert-GitSafe call at :239 do the lock clearing.
Gate the date-pill stamp in release.ps1 on the version pill differing from project.godot's pre-sync config/version, and fail the release when a tracked source file changed but the pill did not.
Port BrackishRising's named-invariant Test-GatePageIntegrity into publish-gdd.ps1 and assert the ENCODED payload read back off disk decodes byte-for-byte to docs/GDD.html.
Delete the gate-page version-chip block at publish-gdd.ps1:193-199, or anchor it to an explicit chip element id that actually exists on the page.
Sweep happy-to and collective we/our out of the changelog and Decisions tab to solo first person, and extend the voice guard's pattern set to cover both classes.
Add an agent-workflow-artifact row at HIGH to the SKILL.md violation and regex tables, narrow the CLAUDE.md skip rule to bare path references, and re-anchor the reference sweep to a v0.99.x example.
Rewrite the repo description to the native-3D framing used in README.md:3 and swap the isometric topic for 3d.
Requalify design.html:161 and README.md:9 to the actual roster state rather than a completed art pass.
Prewarm one enemy model and one unit model during world_3d._ready and amortize spawn_wave across frames with a per-frame instantiation budget.
Point the debug_flags autoload at source/autoloads/debug_flags.tscn in project.godot so the exports are settable in the inspector, or delete the orphan scene and correct the two comments.
Add a full-scene world_3d perf harness with the shipped Zombie1 model and re-derive wave_director.max_alive from its measured knee.
Run a with/without eval for code-audit and htbh-changelog-entry against HBH and store the transcripts as hbh_with_skill.md and hbh_without_skill.md.
Make staged_or_dirty_files abort the run with a non-zero exit when git diff HEAD --name-only returns non-zero or raises, instead of returning an empty set.
Port the BrackishRising fetch-plus-rebase-plus-retry block into HBH's write-dashboard-status.ps1 and move the release.ps1 Step 2.5 call ahead of the publish-gdd step.
Add the Invoke-Git wrapper from X:\YesAndEverything\scripts\git-guard.ps1:55-64 to HBH's git-guard.ps1 and route the git writes in the four scripts through it.

Append the short commit SHA to the composed commit message at push-to-github.ps1:178 and make discord-notify.ps1 abort with a warning when the extracted changelog entry is older than the release date.
Port auto_pause's command-post and enemy-proximity hooks onto enemy_field_3d's position buffer and wire connect_command_post from world_3d._ready, or strip the dead 2D halves.
Add scripts/.wrangler/ to .gitignore and git rm --cached scripts/.wrangler/cache/wrangler-account.json.
Replace the fix-later scaffold line at world_3d.gd:7 with a pointer to tests/world3d_integration_test.gd and its run command.
Run git gc --prune=now in X:\HereBeHordes after confirming no other process holds the repo, then re-run git count-objects -vH to verify.
Add an @export var options_version: int = 1 to source/data/options.gd and read it in global.gd before applying settings.
Add an auto_fix_lane field with its reason to .project-context.json so the constraint survives report retention.
Move the five retired-2D entries at docs/OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md:118-157 into a clearly labelled closed section beneath the profiler walkthrough.
Mark the four unprovisioned rows in CLAUDE.md:135-138 as naming reserved so the handler stops asserting a topology that has no file and no caller.
Switch the palette and interceptor here-strings in publish-gdd.ps1 to single-quoted form, moving the two interpolated marker variables to string concatenation.
Replace the accuracy and willingness-to-act wording at GDD.html:1429 and the accuracy mention at :1514 with damage and defense scaling to match the locked decision at :2739.
Bake the navmesh from collision shapes rather than visual meshes at world_3d.gd:123, :388 and :892 and record the outcome as an OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md row.
Move the world_3d gameplay tick block from _process into _physics_process, leaving the 0.2s HUD and fog refresh where it is.
